summary: Implemented Admin logs page clear button with no-filter POST /api/admin/logs/clear, busy single-flight behavior, success refresh feedback, failure feedback preserving current log content, and updated current-log-only copy.
notes: The clear button calls POST /api/admin/logs/clear without query, level, source, row-count, or search parameters.
While clearing is in flight, the button is disabled and aria-busy=true; duplicate clicks reuse the same request instead of posting again.
Successful clear refreshes /api/admin/logs and shows a visible success status.
Failed clear shows a visible failure status and does not replace the existing rendered log lines with an empty state.

Existing filter, export, auto-refresh, and cleanup behavior is preserved. The page copy now states the default view is the current log file, background mode writes logs/walker.out.log and logs/walker.err.log, and logs/walker.log is only enabled explicitly with WALKER_LOG_FILE=true; it does not promise archive reads or imply default terminal plus walker.log writes.
